string.name: desktop_account_onboarding_purpose_title
string.value: What would you like DeepSeek Harness to help with?

string.name: desktop_account_onboarding_intro
string.value: DeepSeek Harness works in a local folder and uses tools to read and write files on your computer. It can help you research and organize information, create documents and spreadsheets, write code, troubleshoot issues, and more.

string.name: desktop_account_onboarding_credit_description
string.value: DeepSeek Harness charges credits based on the tokens used by models and tools. Add credits in advance to keep your tasks running without interruption. Your balance is only used while the agent is working on a task.

string.name: desktop_account_onboarding_purpose_description
string.value: We’ll tailor the interface and tools to fit the way you work.

string.name: desktop_account_onboarding_office_description
string.value: Edit documents, organize data, create presentations, and more

string.name: desktop_account_onboarding_development_description
string.value: Edit code, debug issues, run commands, manage project files, and more
